description: Renovate rules for PHP repositories. Extend after the org-wide default:
Laravel and its first-party packages release together and are tested together, so bumping
one without the others produces avoidable conflicts.
A Laravel major is a coordinated upgrade, never a routine bump. Hold it back long enough
for the ecosystem to catch up, and keep it out of any group.
Static analysis minors routinely surface new findings, which is a code change disguised as
a dependency bump. Keep them separate so the resulting diff is attributable.

packageRules.description: Patch-level updates to test tooling are safe to merge unattended.
